Talk to a person.

Call (480) 771-4719 or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com for a quote, a question or a booking. Our reservations team answers seven days a week.

Phone and text

Call or text (480) 771-4719. The same number reaches the reservations desk and, on the day, the dispatcher watching your trip.

Email

Write to reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com. Quotes answered within the hour, 8am–10pm.

Hours

Book online any hour. Quotes answered 8am–10pm, seven days; late-night rides inside 48 hours confirmed by 8am.

How far ahead to book

Weddings, large groups and event dates: book 4 to 8 weeks ahead. Everything else: 48 hours is plenty; same-day when we have the vehicle.

What to include in a quote request

The date, the pickup time and address, where you are going, how many passengers, and roughly how many hours you need. That is enough for a firm quote at the published hourly rate; anything else we can settle on the phone.

Where we pick up

Scottsdale, Phoenix, Sky Harbor and the wider Valley: Scottsdale, Phoenix, Paradise Valley, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Cave Creek, San Tan Valley, and day trips anywhere in Arizona.

How a booking is confirmed

A 50% deposit holds the vehicle and the balance is charged to the card on file two days before pickup. Arizona sales tax is added at checkout; there is no booking fee and no service charge.
